newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile sells 115 tonnes of tin in spot sale.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile sells 115 tonnes of tin in spot sale.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 115 tonnes of tin for a total of $668,591 or an average price of $2.637 a pound.

Rotometals bought 5 tonnes at a unit price of $2.65 a lb, Non-Ferrous Processing Corp, 10 tonnes at $2.643 a lb, Zigor 33, 10 tonnes at $2.64 a lb, Ney Smelting, 20 tonnes at $2.6396, RMT, 60 tonnes at $2.635 a lb, and Cambridge Steel, 10 tonnes at $2.6299 a lb.
The next monthly spot offer of stockpiled tin will be on April 2.
